test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Several old buildings were dismantled by them to build the new hospital.

options.text: They have dismantled several old buildings to build the new hospital.
They had dismantled several old buildings to build the new hospital.
They are dismantling several old buildings to build the new hospital.
They dismantled several old buildings to build the new hospital.

solution:
The correct answer is: **They dismantled several old buildings to build the new hospital.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the simple past tense and we need to change it to the active form.
 
• The simple past tense in the passive voice has the following form: Object+ was/were + V3+ by + subject + rest of the sentence__
 
• The simple past tense in the active voice has the following form: __Subject + V2 + object + rest of the sentence__
 __
 
• Passive: * A bicycle was bought by Riya.*
 
• Active: *Riya bought a bicycle.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct passive Voice:__ *They dismantled several old buildings to build the new hospital.*
